scope: Text conversion of eleven retained existing jutsu. Not a Forge manifest, final AI kit, clone request, mechanical patch or live-write authorization.
preservation: All other fields, including the complete ordered effects array and nested descriptions, images/animation, costs, omitted fields and null/empty distinctions, remain exactly as captured. Existing IDs are retained. Do not normalize or repair mechanics.
implementationGates: Director acceptance of the authored presentation text.
Fresh operator full records and all-consumer audit before editing; historical owners here are not an exhaustive dependency list.
Fable freezes hybrid kits, equipped-link handling, AI rules and the revised regular-Captain parity comparator.

Eventual operator workflow: unequip affected links, edit only approved presentation fields, re-equip and verify full records/links under the repository workflow. No game requests are part of this artifact.

offlineVerification.hashMethod: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON after removing only name, description, battleDescription; sorted object keys; separators comma/colon; ensure_ascii=False; array order and omitted fields preserved.

after.name: Core Rupture
after.description: A containment seal ruptures, destroying the casting device in a piercing chakra blast that staggers nearby enemies.
after.battleDescription: %user's containment seal splits, consuming the device in a piercing chakra blast that tears through the surrounding battlefield.

before.name: Ghostly Deep Six
before.description: Six fathoms down, where strength, wounds and prayers all fail.
before.battleDescription: %user sends %target six fathoms down where strength fails, wounds stay open and prayers go unanswered.

after.name: Suppression Writ
after.description: A command seal weakens the target's attacks, leaves them more vulnerable, and impairs their healing ability.
after.battleDescription: %user casts a suppression writ upon %target, its tightening script dulling their strikes, opening their guard, and disrupting their healing chakra.

before.name: Ghostly Final Fathom
before.description: The last fathom takes your strength, your gifts, and your time.
before.battleDescription: %user sends the anchor down with %target lashed to the chain, the last fathom taking strength, gifts and time together.

after.name: Final Command
after.description: A crushing command strike disrupts the target's actions and attempts to suppress their bloodline effects.
after.battleDescription: %user drives a command seal toward %target with a crushing blow, its flaring script threatening to scatter their rhythm and suppress their bloodline power.

before.name: Death's Grasp
before.battleDescription: %user eyes flare menacingly as they cackle at %target. With a sudden gesture they summon a series of pale ghostly hands which latch onto %target, sapping their life force and rendering them immobile

after.name: Keelbind
after.description: Chakra moorings strike and anchor the target while draining health, chakra, and stamina over time.
after.battleDescription: %user lashes chakra moorings at %target, the lines closing around their footing as a draining pulse runs through each strand.

before.name: Ghostly Shipwreck Delusion
before.description: The whole sea breaks at once.
before.battleDescription: %user breaks the whole sea at once, a phantom fleet shattering over %target from every direction there is.

after.name: Ruin Refrain
after.description: The ship's remembered destruction erupts across the battlefield as a chakra projection of shattering timbers and staggering impacts.
after.battleDescription: %user releases the ship's memory of ruin, sending a storm of fractured timbers and concussive chakra across the battlefield.

before.name: Counter Stance
before.description: A posture that returns what it receives.
before.battleDescription: %user takes a counter stance; what strikes them answers for it.

after.name: Rebounding Form
after.description: A practiced chakra posture returns a portion of incoming direct damage to its source.
after.battleDescription: %user settles into a measured form, shaping a retaliatory chakra field that answers incoming blows with returning force.

before.name: Death's Door
before.battleDescription: %user calls upon the power of Death itself to grow ever stronger

after.name: Unbroken Command
after.description: An enduring command imprint sharpens offensive technique and lends greater force to attacks.
after.battleDescription: %user draws upon an unbroken command imprint, old orders burning through their reconstructed form as their offensive power rises.

before.name: Ghostly Crossed Out
before.description: Your name is struck through; what you carry is forfeit.
before.battleDescription: %user strikes %target's name from the ledger with one heavy line, and what %target carries is declared forfeit.

after.name: Revocation Strike
after.description: A strike of seal-marked metal attempts to suppress the target's bloodline effects.
after.battleDescription: %user strikes at %target with seal-marked metal, its flaring script seeking to suppress their bloodline power.

before.name: Ghostly Rigging Snare
before.description: Living rigging lashes out and pins the target in place.
before.battleDescription: %user hurls living rigging at %target, ropes coiling around their legs and cinching them to the deck.

after.name: Rigging Snare
after.description: Seal-threaded rigging lashes the target and briefly pins them in place.
after.battleDescription: %user lashes seal-threaded rigging at %target, the lines snapping shut around their footing.

before.name: Ghostly Strangling Weed
before.description: Wet weed winds around the throat and drinks.
before.battleDescription: %user winds wet strangling weed around %target's throat and chest, drinking their strength as it tightens.

after.name: Hollow Timber
after.description: Corrupted wooden growth strikes the target and drains health, chakra, and stamina over time.
after.battleDescription: %user drives a surge of hollow timber toward %target, its splintered grain carrying a pulse that drains life, chakra, and stamina.

before.name: Battle Trance
before.description: Heightened strength of body and mind.
before.battleDescription: %user enters a battle trance, strength rising.

after.name: Remembered Form
after.description: A preserved combat pattern sharpens the user's strongest offensive discipline.
after.battleDescription: %user settles into a remembered combat form, each practiced movement sharpening their offensive technique.
